The 7z and bzip2 samples were generated for this project; they contain only
small text files. The password for the encrypted 7z samples is `secret`.

The two RAR samples come from the libarchive project (BSD license):
- https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/blob/master/libarchive/test/test_read_format_rar.rar.uu
- https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/blob/master/libarchive/test/test_read_format_rar5_stored.rar.uu
- https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/blob/master/COPYING
